'''Larvon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] mining prospector living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3637 BBY]] along with his partner [[Ushanna]] he ventured to [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] to search for [[Exonium/Legends|exonium]] deposits, using the village of the native [[Rishii/Legends|Rishii]] on the [[Sky Ridge Island]] as their base camp.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Larvon appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]].
